info.name: Nine Fives Programmable REST Attenuator Network API

items.docs: Returns network configuration for both the Ethernet and USB-C interfaces, including configured settings and live interface information.

Updates network configuration and applies it immediately. Ethernet, USB-C, or both interfaces may be updated in a single request; only include fields to change. Changing network settings while connected may result in loss of connectivity.
